title: VR-Compassion Cultivation Training
description: This dataset comprises EEG recordings collected during a virtual reality-based compassion cultivation training (VR-CCT) study conducted in the immersive social environment of Compassion Island. Participants engaged in guided meditations, visualization exercises, and interactive role-play scenarios with animated characters designed to cultivate compassion. The study integrates neuroimaging data with behavioral observations from a multi-setting virtual environment to investigate the neural correlates of compassion training augmented through immersive technology.
methods_description: EEG data were collected during VR-based compassion cultivation training sessions conducted in AltspaceVR's Compassion Island environment. Sessions included three main components: guided meditation in a meditation hall with breath regulation assistance, compassion visualization exercises in a garden setting, and interactive clinical role-play with a virtual patient character. Participants engaged in free conversation with live actor-controlled avatars representing a guide and a patient.
